story: Kofi and Hana are in the kitchen. They prepare their favorite breakfast together. Hana makes tea and Kofi cuts bread. They laugh and enjoy their morning.
title: A Happy Breakfast
setting: A bright kitchen in the morning.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: A young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: A young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress.

sentences.en: Hana is ready for the breakfast time.
sentences.zh: Hana 准备好早餐时间了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress, stands in a bright kitchen.

sentences.en: Hot tea is her favorite drink.
sentences.zh: 热茶是她最喜欢的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana holds a steaming cup of tea in her hands.

sentences.en: Kofi gets a loaf of bread.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt, holds a big loaf of bread.

sentences.en: He uses a knife to cut it.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi uses a silver knife to cut the bread on the table.

sentences.en: The bread is between the two plates.
sentences.scene_prompt: A loaf of bread sits on the table between two white plates.

sentences.en: He puts the bread down slowly.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢地把面包放了下来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi puts a piece of bread down on a white plate.

sentences.en: They laugh at a funny joke.
sentences.zh: 他们为一个笑话而发笑。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi and Hana are sitting at the table and laughing happily.

sentences.en: Hana says thanks to her friend.
sentences.zh: Hana 向她的朋友说谢谢。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana smiles at Kofi while sitting at the kitchen table.

sentences.en: He needs to change his wet sock.
sentences.zh: 他需要更换他湿的袜子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi looks at a wet blue sock on the floor.

sentences.en: He runs to the small bathroom.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi runs toward a small door labeled with a bathroom icon.

sentences.en: It is eighteen minutes past eight.
sentences.scene_prompt: A round clock on the kitchen wall shows the time.

sentences.en: They see a boat in the east.
sentences.zh: 他们看到东方有一艘船。
sentences.scene_prompt: Through the kitchen window, a small boat is visible on the water in the distance.
